Every good strategy starts with one question: where are we going to be in five years? First, choose a long-term goal. For example, we are going to become the biggest fruit exporter in our region. Then, divide it into small targets for every year. A target must have a number and a date. Next, choose your priorities. You can't do everything, so choose three things and say no to the rest. Remember that every investment has a risk. Think about the risks before you decide. And finally, be realistic about the future. Nobody knows what will happen in the market next year, but a company with a clear plan will see an opportunity faster than a company without one.

Good evening, everyone. This is Marcos, the CEO. I want to share our plans for next year. First, we are going to open a small sales office in Rotterdam, because Europe is our biggest opportunity. Second, we are going to invest in two new machines for the iron plant. It is a big investment, but it will reduce the risk of problems like the one we had last month. Our target is simple: ten percent more exports by December. I think it will be a hard year, but I am sure it will be a good one. Rafael is going to lead the new partnership with Harbor Fresh Foods. Thank you all, and see you at the board meeting on Monday.

First, the board chooses a long-term goal for the next five years. Then, they divide the goal into small targets for every year. Next, they choose three priorities and say no to the rest. After that, they think about the risks of every investment. Finally, Rafael presents the plan, and the team promises that they will follow it.
